dedupe_keys.name: occupants adaptive behaviour and air conditioning use in brazilian residential buildings questionnaire data

description: This dataset holds responses to a questionnaire applied across Brazil to characterise how residents adapt to indoor conditions and use air conditioning at home. It was deposited on Mendeley Data in 2020 by Greici Ramos. It contains the response data (DATA.csv), a notes file that explains column names and factor levels, and the questionnaire as applied (PDF), covering occupant behaviour such as opening windows, using fans and switching air conditioners on. Coverage: respondents throughout the Brazilian territory. Access: open download from Mendeley Data. Licence: Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0; free for non-commercial use. Caveats: self-reported answers from a convenience sample, so results are not nationally representative; the sample size and period are given in the files, not the record. Simulation uses are occupant behaviour models and air conditioning schedules in residential energy and overheating simulation for hot climates. Related records: BuildOcc and the Brazil future weather files.
name: Occupants' adaptive behaviour and air conditioning use in Brazilian residential buildings (questionnaire data)

sources.note: Creator, Mendeley 2020, CC BY-NC 3.0, description of files
